title: Ezra pill button
description: A 50px pill link in two styles: solid terracotta with cream text that turns midnight on hover, or a white outline pill whose pale grey hairline darkens to ink on hover. Optional leading icon.
notes: hover is a 200ms colour change, as the original
name: ezra-button

props.name: variant
props.description: solid (terracotta) or outline (white with a hairline)

props.name: icon
props.description: a small icon before the label (e.g. a lucide Play)
